name: Sirio Finance
rootCause: Sirio Finance on Hedera was exploited on February 1, 2025 through a spot price manipulation attack on its lending protocol, resulting in approximately $2 million reported losses. The oracle relied on a manipulable AMM pool price, allowing flash loan-driven attacks. Sirio Finance's lending protocol used a spot price oracle tied to a single AMM pool. The attacker manipulated this pool's price using flash loans, causing the oracle to reflect an artificial asset value and enabling undercollateralized borrowing.
